senses: a small reptile, probably a kind of lizard, which is unclean
perhaps an extinct animal, exact meaning is unknown

strongs.def: vigor, literally (force, in a good or a bad sense) or figuratively (capacity, means, produce); also (from its hardiness) a large lizard
strongs.kjv: ability, able, chameleon, force, fruits, might, power(-ful), strength, substance, wealth
strongs.from: or (Daniel 11:6) כּוֹחַ; from an unused root meaning to be firm
